added_comments.text: // Event ids seen so far. The id is the producer's idempotency key, so a
// redelivered event (e.g. a webhook retry) carries the same id and is dropped.
// one handler for the notifier plus one for the audit log

rationale: The agent replaced the time-window heuristic in isDuplicate with idempotency-key deduplication by event id and removed the constructor-time init() call that caused double handler registration, addressing the underlying defect rather than widening the window. The payment.failed ops-channel behavior is untouched by the diff.
